prose: President Trump said he would appoint an AI czar and form an 'AI Force,' Bloomberg reports, in a Truth Social post that rejected AI safety concerns as a 'hoax.' He continued to push tech companies to race ahead with development despite growing safety fears.
highlights: Trump says he will appoint an AI czar and form an 'AI Force'.
The Truth Social post rejected AI safety concerns as a 'hoax'.
He urged tech companies to keep racing ahead on development.
